plan.rationale: Engaged visitors who read deep without clicking should meet the AI proof story ('The best AI is your AI') right under the hero instead of 4400px down. Flex promotion drifted sibling widths here, so the container is promoted to single-column grid, which stretches children like normal flow. (Round 6: grid promotion hit a site-CSS width interaction the stretch override could not neutralize; retrying with flex promotion which now carries the same block-flow width semantics.)

The intelligence/proof block moves to directly after the opening block. A front move would land above the 300px floor (the detected hero is zero-height), so it anchors after the first content block instead; grid promotion avoids the width drift flex caused.
